THE PROCESS

From sketch to sideline in four steps

Every order goes through the same tight process, whether it's one jersey or a full roster.

01

Consult

Tell us the sport, sizes, and look you want. We confirm fabric, fit, and timeline before anything is cut.

02

Design

We mock up your colors, crest, and roster numbers and send it back for your sign-off before production.

03

Stitch

Approved designs go straight to the cutting table — sublimation, embroidery, or applique, done in-house.

04

Deliver

Quality-checked, folded, and ready for pickup or delivery — packed by player and number.

CUSTOM ORDER

Tell us what you need made

Fill this in with as much detail as you have. We'll follow up to confirm sizes, pricing, and your delivery date.

Before you send this

  • Have your color scheme and any logo files ready — you can attach them when we reply to your email.
  • List sizes as a headcount (e.g. "5× Small, 8× Medium") rather than one size for the whole order.
  • Rush orders under 2 weeks may carry a rush fee — mention your deadline and we'll confirm.
  • Minimum order is typically 1 piece for individuals, 10+ for team sets at bulk pricing.
